flowRoot.flowPara: Components Needed
Table of Contents
2: Overview, Components
3: Setup, Stats and Traits
4: Script Start, Turn Phases I & II
5: Turn Phase III, Death's Grasp, Death's Caress, Unquenched
6: Grave Smash, Carrion Spew, Welcoming Dead
7: Welcoming Dead (Minion)
8: Rewards, Scaling, Credits
Encounter Overview
Golgothon the Restless is a beginner level encounter for Boss Fight: Tactics Arena. It is tuned to be a good challenge for players who are new to the game.
This encounter pits the players against a "graveyard elemental" and its zombie minions. The primary challenges for the players are:

• the Death's Grasp / Death's Caress combo. Death's Grasp pulls the players to Golgothon, while Death's Caress (which is always cast the following turn) causes extreme damage to players who remain close. This would be a simple challenge, except...

• the Welcoming Dead minions spawned by Golgothon limit player movement, forcing the players to deal with the minions or risk being trapped within reach of Death's Caress. The minions themselves start as a minor threat, but...

• due to Unquenched, the battle increases in difficulty as it wears on. If the players are unable to defeat Golgothon, they will fall to the ever-growing horde of increasingly fast and deadly minions.
This encounter uses following components (in addition to any components used for player-controlled units):
• 25 map tiles • scrap paper
• 30 minion tokens
• 2 daze debuff tokens
• targeting deck

flowRoot.flowPara: • Health: 8
Minion Subscript:
• Starting with the Welcoming Dead minion nearest to the northwest corner of the battlefield, each one uses Welcoming Arms.
Welcoming Dead
Welcoming Arms
Move 0(±1) squares toward the nearest foe. Then, strike a random foe in melee range for 2(±1).
Drag You Down
While at least 2 Welcoming Dead minions are adjacent to a player, that player may not take move actions or use move, shift or fly effects.
Restless
When a Welcoming Dead minion is slain, place a Restless Dead marker on its square.
The Welcoming Dead

The Welcoming Dead minions that Golgothon summons in step VI play a vital role in this encounter. They primarily act as an obstacle, blocking players' movement around the field - both by just taking up space and thanks to their innate Drag You Down skill. While easy to kill or avoid, these minions respawn - and get faster and more deadly - each time that Golgothon uses Unquenched.
Don't forget to replace slain minions with Restless Dead markers.
>> These minions do move when using Welcoming Arms until Golgothon has at least 1 Unquenched stack.
>> Drag You Down does not prevent teleporting or swapping. It also doesn't prevent any other effects of a skill that generates move, shift or fly.
>> Rather than use a separate marker for Restless Dead markers, simply flip the token over.
>> Restless Dead markers do not occupy their squares and can be moved through freely.
>> If Unquenched causes a minion to respawn in an occupied square, it is immediately moved to the nearest unoccupied square.
Phase IV: End Phase
There are no encounter actions during this phase. Once the players have completed any end-of-turn triggered effects, return to Script Start (p. 4)
The undead surrounding you grip you tightly, blocking your movement.
Read the following when Drag You Down prevents movement:
